Knowledge Notes.Knowledge: Charging-grid history contains dog-carriage, back-pulley, tie-rod, track-beam and coupling replacement records.
Use carriage, pulley, tie-rod, track/rail, coupling, drive and lubrication as inspection subjects; exact intervals should follow approved inspection standards.
BSY history includes roller, gearbox, tyre and coupling records.
Inspect rollers, gearbox oil/leakage, tyres/couplings, bearings, alignment, lubrication and abnormal noise/vibration.
Elevator history contains chain-related maintenance records.
Inspect chains, sprockets, bearings, gearbox, guides, lubrication, tension and alignment.
LTP history contains brake/rail/stop-related parts and maintenance records.
Inspect rails, stops, brackets/structures, fasteners and wear parts as applicable.
BTD history records arms and plate/block related items.
Inspect arms, plate/block interfaces, wear and fastening condition.
Bloom pusher history records carriage/guide wheel items.
Inspect carriage, guide wheels, guides, drive and structural condition.
FART history includes coupling, roller and tyre replacement/defect records.
Inspect roller, tyre, coupling, bearing, gearbox and alignment.
WBF-1 has separate historical records for furnace, wheels, gearboxes, sprockets, pulleys, lintels, skids, recuperator and related systems.
Walking Beam hydraulic documentation describes lift/transfer/lower/return functions and hydraulic components.
WBF-2 has separate historical maintenance and defect records; use those failures as RCM evidence.
ECS records include turbine pumps, mechanical-seal leakage, bearings, alignment, valves and piping.
Monitor pump vibration/temperature, seal leakage, alignment, bearings, valves, flow/pressure and pipe condition.
BDM sequence: Stand-7 → Measuring Roll → Pinch Roll → Flying Shear → DTCT → TOCB.
Stand-7 vertical roll reference: 630/555 mm max/min; normal gap about 166.6 mm; new-pass commissioning gap about 171–172 mm.
Reference data: blade life 150,000 t; blade gap 0.4–0.6 mm; blade+pad thickness 130 mm; notch height 207 mm; torque 1500 N·m.
Inspect crankshaft, gears, bearings, blades, pads, lubrication, coupling and alignment.
Manual: 2 lift cylinders + 1 transfer cylinder; 3000 L oil tank; conditioning pumps; pilot pumps; main variable-displacement axial-piston pumps.
Handbook pressure references: 12 bar standby, 13 bar slowdown, 20 bar transfer, 27 bar lift/lower. Temperature references: 15°C start, 25°C heater ON, 30°C heater OFF, 65°C max/alarm.
Field inspection points include oil, pressure, vibration and leakage; troubleshooting covers lift, transfer and lowering.

Troubleshooting.Checks / Guidance: Check approved isolation/interlocks; inspect mechanical obstruction, rope/pulley/carriage, track/rail, coupling and gearbox.
Check drive, coupling, gearbox, bearings, roller seizure/alignment and lubrication.
Check chain tension/alignment, sprocket condition, bearing/gearbox, obstruction and lubrication.
Check tyre wear/damage, coupling, roller alignment, bearing/gearbox and fastening.
Check hydraulic pressure/pilot pressure, valve/solenoid status, limit switches, cylinder leakage, accumulator/check valves; follow approved emergency procedure.
Check suction/discharge, seal, bearing, coupling/alignment, cooler/piping and standby readiness.
Check lubrication path/nozzles, pump/pressure/flow and blocked nozzles; replace defective nozzles as required.
Check blade gap/condition, crank alignment, pinch-roll centering, billet approach/alignment, guides, coupling and gearbox.
Check rollers/transfer mechanism, stops/guides, drive/coupling, alignment and obstruction.

SMP.Title: SMP – Mechanical inspection
SMP.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation/LOTO → guards/coupling → bearing temperature/vibration → lubrication → alignment/fastening → trial run → record.

SMP.Title: SMP – Gearbox inspection
SMP.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation → oil level/leakage/condition → breather → temperature/vibration → lubrication nozzles → abnormal noise → record.

SMP.Title: SMP – Hydraulic inspection
SMP.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation → oil level/temp → pressure → leakage → filters → pumps → accumulator → valves/cylinders → record.

SMP.Title: SMP – Walking beam inspection
SMP.Procedure / Guidance: Approved shutdown/isolation → wheels/guides/sprockets/pulleys → clearances → lubrication → structure → approved functional test.

SMP.Title: SMP – ECS pump inspection
SMP.Procedure / Guidance: Standby readiness → vibration/temp → seal → bearing → coupling/alignment → suction/discharge → flow/pressure → record.

SOP.Title: SOP – Safe maintenance workflow
SOP.Procedure / Guidance: Identify job → risk assessment/permit → LOTO → tools/spares verification → maintenance → inspection/measurement → trial run → handover.

SOP.Title: SOP – Shift log entry
SOP.Procedure / Guidance: Select exact equipment → enter shift/date → record observation → attach image → review/confirm → classify defect → assign action.

SOP.Title: SOP – Vibration/temperature monitoring
SOP.Procedure / Guidance: Select equipment and point → record H/V/A, temperature, RPM and operating condition → compare approved limit/trend → create action.

SOP.Title: SOP – Spare verification
SOP.Procedure / Guidance: Select equipment → verify part/CAT/SAP/drawing → check stock/minimum → issue/replace → update stock/history.

Mapping Rules.Authorised behaviour: Area + equipment + sub-equipment + defect/job/history text + remarks + source sheet/file + exact IDs are analysed together.
FUR is area/context, not an equipment. Resolve WBF/ECS/CAF/door/recuperator only when evidence supports it.
F1/Furnace1/WBF1→WBF-1; F2/Furnace2/WBF2→WBF-2; ECS1/ECS2→ECS-1/ECS-2; recup variants→Recuperator when unambiguous.
pump/motor/bearing/valve/pipe/gearbox/coupling/stand remain ambiguous unless context uniquely resolves them.
Actual numeric vibration/load/thickness evidence is distinct from maintenance text mentioning those words.
Manual/reference text is not converted into an event unless source explicitly records an event.
Deduplicate for analytics but preserve every source trace.
Malformed/missing dates are preserved and flagged; never invented.
